text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Seri~~ously, where is our great detective????

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "No, seriously, lately I've just been a total mystery to myself!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: First, racing! It's crazy fun, but honestly, I just can't get into the groove of it!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I thought maybe I just needed to get hyped, so I went
karaokeing with my besties, but weirdly I couldn't get into it?!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: And then my besties just went home after randomly telling me, "Get some rest"...?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "No matter how much I run, I'm still mysteriously sluggish...????"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Nhahaha, somehow that makes me super sad!

It seems running in too many consecutive races
has caused stress and fatigue to pile up.
I should probably reconsider her race schedule...
